semantics.label: Introduction
semantics.description: Optional text shown before the learner starts the image flash. May contain HTML.

fields.label: Image
fields.description: Image shown briefly after the learner starts the flash.

fields.label: Alternative text
fields.description: Describe the flash image for screen reader users. Strongly recommended whenever the image carries meaning for the task.

fields.label: Display duration (seconds)
fields.description: How long the image stays visible after start. Allowed range: 0.1–10 seconds.

fields.label: Task description
fields.description: A guide telling the user how to answer this task.

fields.label: Text with blanks
fields.description: Mark each blank with three or more underscores (___). Do not put the answers in the text.

fields.label: Correct answer
fields.description: One answer for this blank, in the same order as the blanks in the text. Separate alternative answers with a slash (/).

fields.label: Define custom feedback for any score range
fields.description: Click the "Add range" button to add as many ranges as you need. Example: 0-20% Bad score, 21-91% Average Score, 91-100% Great Score!

semantics.label: Behavioural settings
semantics.description: How often the image may be shown, and how the fill-in task behaves.

fields.label: Maximum flash views
fields.description: How many times the learner may see the image in one attempt, including the first flash. Use 0 for unlimited.

fields.label: Answer mode
fields.description: Indicates in what way the user gives answers.

options.label: The user types in the answers.
The incorrect answers entered for the blank
The correct answers of all other blanks

fields.label: Maximum number of alternatives of other blanks offered for selection
Behaviour when the user makes a spelling error

options.label: Accept it as a correct answer
Warn the user about the error

fields.label: Case sensitive
fields.description: If enabled, capitalization that is different from the solution is considered an error.

fields.label: Require all fields to be answered before the solution can be viewed
Not filled out message
fields.default: Please fill in all blanks to view solution

fields.label: Spelling mistake warning
fields.description: Insert @mistake to show the misspelled word.

fields.label: Check button description
fields.default: Check the answers. The responses will be marked as correct, incorrect, or unanswered.

fields.label: Show solution button description
fields.default: Show the solution. The task will be marked with its correct solution.

fields.label: Retry button description
fields.default: Retry the task. Reset all responses and start the task over again.

fields.label: Body text
fields.default: Are you sure you wish to finish?

fields.label: Body text
fields.default: Are you sure you wish to retry?
